## 1. Creating a Template-Based Project in Positron

- Create a new project in Positron using the provided template.
- Make sure all necessary folders and files are included in the project.
- Sync or pull the latest version before making changes when collaborating through GitHub.

## 2. Quarto YAML Settings

- The YAML section is located at the top of a `.qmd` file.
- It controls basic document settings such as the title, author, format, and output options.
- Proper YAML settings help maintain consistent formatting when rendering the project.
